status: DRAFT written as placeholder copy. The owner must read, edit and approve every line before any book is printed.

tokens.{name}: the child's first name, as the parent typed it
tokens.{Subj}: He, She or They (start of a sentence)
tokens.{Poss}: His, Her or Their (start of a sentence)
tokens.{Obj}: Him, Her or Them (start of a sentence)

style: Short lines to read aloud. Warm, simple words (suits ages 1 to 7). Each profession has a rhyme for the picture page, one true fact, and one encouraging line. Avoid verbs that depend on he, she or they, so the same text works for every child.

rhyme: When {name} grows up, what will {name} be?
There is so much to try and so much to see!
Let us visit some jobs, one by one,
and find out which ones are the most fun!
Whatever you choose, {name}, you can do it too.
Be curious, be kind, and always be you.
The world is waiting for all you will do.
We believe in you, {name}, and we love you!

doctor.title: Doctor
rhyme: Thump-thump, thump-thump, listen well,
{name} has a heartbeat story to tell.
With gentle hands and a caring smile,
a doctor helps friends all the while.
doctor.funFact: A doctor uses a stethoscope to listen to your heartbeat.
doctor.motivation: Kind hearts make the best doctors. Keep being kind, {name}!

pilot.title: Pilot
rhyme: Up, up, up, above the trees,
{name} soars along on the morning breeze.
Over the mountains, over the sea,
the sky says, 'Come and fly with me!'
pilot.funFact: Aeroplanes fly higher than most clouds, where the sky is bright and clear.
pilot.motivation: Every pilot starts by dreaming big. Keep dreaming, {name}!

astronaut.title: Astronaut
rhyme: Three, two, one, blast off to the stars!
{name} zooms past the Moon and Mars.
Floating, floating, light as air,
an astronaut waves hello up there.
astronaut.funFact: In space there is no up or down, so astronauts float like feathers.
astronaut.motivation: Astronauts never stop wondering. Keep wondering, {name}!

scientist.title: Scientist
rhyme: Why is the sky blue? Why does rain fall?
{name} asks questions about it all.
A curious mind and a try-it-and-see,
that is how scientists learn to be.
scientist.funFact: Scientists ask 'why?' and then try things out to find the answer.
scientist.motivation: Every great scientist was once a curious child. Keep asking why, {name}!

artist.title: Artist
rhyme: Red and yellow, blue and green,
{name} paints the brightest scene.
Splish, splash, swish, a rainbow grows,
a happy picture everyone knows.
artist.funFact: When you mix blue paint and yellow paint together, you get green.
artist.motivation: There is no wrong way to make art. Keep creating, {name}!

chef.title: Chef
rhyme: Stir, stir, stir the yummy stew,
{name} cooks up something good for you.
A pinch of this and a dash of that,
a chef wears a tall white hat!
chef.funFact: Chefs taste their food while they cook, to make it just right.
chef.motivation: Good cooks try new tastes and love to share. Be brave and try, {name}!

footballer.title: Footballer
rhyme: Run, run, run and kick the ball,
{name} dribbles past them all.
Pass to a friend and shout, 'Hooray!'
Teamwork wins the game today.
footballer.funFact: A football team has eleven players on the pitch.
footballer.motivation: Teams win when friends help each other. Keep being a great teammate, {name}!

cricketer.title: Cricketer
rhyme: Swing the bat and hear it crack,
{name} hits the ball way back.
Run, run, run, then catch and throw,
cricket is fun wherever you go.
cricketer.funFact: In cricket, one team bats while the other team bowls and catches.
cricketer.motivation: Every player keeps on practising. Never give up, {name}!

engineer.title: Engineer
rhyme: Bricks and beams and bridges tall,
{name} plans and builds them all.
Measure it, build it, test it twice,
making the world work smooth and nice.
engineer.funFact: Engineers design bridges strong enough for trucks, trains and people.
engineer.motivation: Engineers try again when things fall down. Never give up, {name}!

teacher.title: Teacher
rhyme: Show me letters, show me sums,
{name} teaches, and learning comes.
Every question, big or small,
helps us grow and learn it all.
teacher.funFact: Teachers help people learn new things every day, and they keep learning too.
teacher.motivation: The best teachers never stop learning. Keep learning, {name}!

musician.title: Musician
rhyme: Strum the strings and tap the drum,
{name} plays and everyone hums.
Sing a song that makes hearts dance,
music gives the world a chance.
musician.funFact: You hit a drum, blow a flute and pluck a guitar to make music.
musician.motivation: Every musician starts with just one note. Keep practising, {name}!

firefighter.title: Firefighter
rhyme: Nee-naw, nee-naw, hear the bell,
{name} rushes to help as well.
Brave and careful, kind and strong,
helping people all day long.
firefighter.funFact: Firefighters wear special clothes that keep them safe while they help.
firefighter.motivation: Brave people are kind people too. Keep being brave and kind, {name}!

veterinarian.title: Veterinarian
rhyme: A fluffy bunny, a puppy so small,
{name} takes care of them all.
A gentle check and a kind little pat,
vets help animals, and that is that!
veterinarian.funFact: A vet is a doctor for animals, from tiny hamsters to big horses.
veterinarian.motivation: Being gentle with animals is a superpower. Keep caring, {name}!

architect.title: Architect
rhyme: Draw a line and draw a square,
{name} dreams up buildings everywhere.
Tall ones, round ones, painted bright,
a plan on paper takes its flight.
architect.funFact: Architects draw a plan for a building before anyone starts to build it.
architect.motivation: Big buildings begin as small ideas. Keep imagining, {name}!

photographer.title: Photographer
rhyme: Click! A picture, smile for me!
{name} catches what we see.
A flower, a bird, a sunny day,
a photo helps them stay and stay.
photographer.funFact: A camera lets in light to make a picture.
photographer.motivation: Look closely and you will spot wonderful things. Keep looking, {name}!

explorer.title: Explorer
rhyme: With a map and a compass, off we go,
{name} wonders where the rivers flow.
Over hills and through the trees,
adventure waits in every breeze.
explorer.funFact: The needle of a compass always points to the north.
explorer.motivation: Explorers are brave and curious. Keep exploring, {name}!
